About

JUST
KYU.

I'm Kyu — 17, from Texas, figuring it out. I work at AT&T as a Corporate Assistant Accounts Manager, make content, ride my Kawasaki Ninja 250, game on PC, and spend too much time on my cars — a Saturn Ion, a Mercedes-Benz C240, and a Volvo S60.

Built Scentborne from the ground up — a curated fragrance shop with genuine, premium scents at real prices. Took over CEO at 16. Sold in 2026.
